system.description: When you are injured, your flesh knits with terrible scars and puckering seams. Every time you take a wound you gain the Negative Trait Repugnant, which persists even after the injury heals. After a day's sleep your skin finally restores itself, but until you have slept the marks remain a problem for the Masquerade.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
